Purpose & context

Kushal is building MyRestaurant — a self-hosted, single-restaurant management system licensed under AGPL-3.0, built on .NET 10 Blazor (static SSR with interactive server islands), PostgreSQL via Dapper only (EF Core explicitly forbidden), DbUp startup migrations, rootless Podman Compose, and OpenTelemetry. The repo is kusl/myrestaurant on GitHub. The dependency direction is WebApplication → DataAccess → Domain (Domain is BCL-only). Authentication uses ASP.NET Core Identity with custom Dapper stores, Argon2id password hashing, WebAuthn passkeys, and TOTP. Tests use xUnit v3 with Testcontainers against real PostgreSQL; no Moq, no FluentAssertions (AwesomeAssertions available but plain xUnit Assert preferred). Playwright covers end-to-end scenarios.

The project follows a rigorous slice-based delivery methodology within numbered milestones (M1–M6). M1–M5 are complete. M6 (hardening) is in progress, focused on menu enhancement, mobile layout, end-to-end test coverage, CI/CD, and operational hardening.

Current state

Active work is M6 Stage 4 of the menu enhancement plan (docs/MENU_AND_HANDHELD_PLAN.md):

Slice 54 (most recent): Added picture event history reader and panel (IMenuItemImageEventLog, DapperMenuItemImageEventLog). Fixed F-104 (Razor syntax error from prior archive) and F-105 (image event vocabulary specification had wrong type count and biconditional count). A gate was added to MenuEventVocabularyContractTests asserting every migration-declared event type has a sentence on the rendering surface. Archive: m6-slice-54-picture-history.tar.gz (13 files). The F-105 gate — asserting Razor switch arms against migration vocabulary — was flagged as vetoable with explicit reversion instructions in _CHANGES.md.
Browser downscaling is explicitly named as the next slice — the only remaining obstacle between the image feature and end users.
Current predicted test count: ~1250 (noting the prior baseline of 1242 was itself unverified due to a build failure).

On the horizon

Key learnings & principles

SHA-256 tree reconstruction: At the start of each session, Claude reconstructs the full working tree from dump.txt using SHA-256 verification. This has caught significant session-memory drift (multiple times, by 5–6 slices). The BUILD_PROGRESS narrative records drift events explicitly.
One change, one green run rule: Two changes may ride together only when their failure modes are distinguishable. This is reasoned explicitly per slice.
Findings ledger discipline: Every finding gets an F-number, a ledger row in DOCUMENTATION_REVIEW.md, and an entry in Appendix A of the specification. Unenforceable prose is deleted rather than corrected (F-77 ruling). Counts are deleted rather than corrected (established pattern).
No vacuous gates (F-41): Gates must not reach past what they can decide. Gates must be proven sensitive by planting defects before delivery.
Subjects computed, not listed (F-47/F-58): Where a rule can be executed against the tree, a hardcoded list must not exist.
Declared, not merely mentioned (F-67): CSS shared vocabulary must be declared once, not referenced in comments.
§18 arithmetic discipline: Test count predictions are stated and verified arithmetically before closing every slice. Any deviation from the predicted count is the first thing to investigate.
Razor reserved words: @section must never be used as a variable name (RZ2005/RZ1011). Loop variables named section cause RZ9979. These are standing rules across all sessions.
string.Create pattern (CS1620): Every operand in a string.Create addition chain must be a $"…" interpolated string — plain string literals will not compile.
No await in interpolated string holes (CS4007): Caught and fixed multiple times; now a standing scan before packaging.
Dapper/Npgsql DateTime mapping: Npgsql materializes timestamptz as UTC DateTime; Dapper constructor binding refuses DateTimeOffset. Fix pattern: read as DateTime?, project to DateTimeOffset? via new DateTimeOffset(DateTime.SpecifyKind(value, DateTimeKind.Utc)). Internal row types with DateTime fields plus a ToSummary() projection is the established pattern.
UUIDv7 monotonicity: Guid.CreateVersion7() is unordered within a millisecond (49.8% inversion rate). IIdentifierFactory.Create() guarantees monotonicity via a 12-bit counter in rand_a (RFC 9562 §6.2 method 1) with compare-and-swap. All ordering assertions must use ToByteArray(bigEndian: true) because Guid.CompareTo disagrees with PostgreSQL's uuid collation.
Menu image reader must not JOIN menu_item_image: Replaced and removed pictures delete their rows; an INNER JOIN would silently return only current-photograph history.
Static form file upload transport: Plain enctype="multipart/form-data" posting to the page itself under @formname, reading HttpContext.Request.Form.Files — costs nothing because Blazor's static form handling has already read the body.

Approach & patterns

Session workflow: Kushal provides dump.txt (full repo export with SHA-256 per file) and optionally claude-terminal.txt (build/test output). Claude reconstructs the tree, verifies hashes, re-plans from the tree's own open items, authors all changes, and delivers a complete .tar.gz archive.
Deliverable format (non-negotiable): Structured .tar.gz with repo-relative paths, extractable at the repository root in one operation. Full files for every changed file — never diffs, patches, or bespoke text-manipulation scripts. Explicit delete list (even when empty). git add instructions for new untracked files (gates use git ls-files). Test count prediction stated before delivery.
Documentation updated atomically: Every slice updates DOCUMENTATION_REVIEW.md, Appendix A, TECHNICAL_SPECIFICATION.md (with version number and changelog), BUILD_PROGRESS.md (full narrative slice entry), MENU_AND_HANDHELD_PLAN.md (stage sections), and _CHANGES.md. Specification carries a version number and changelog entry every slice.
Verification before packaging: Razor tag-tree walk, CSS vocabulary check, cell-label arithmetic, spec version gate, Markdown table gate (25 documents), §16.4 counted-class gate, byte hygiene (no CR, final newline, no whitespace-only lines). "What was NOT verified" is documented explicitly in BUILD_PROGRESS.
Veto points: Decisions worth reversing are flagged explicitly with reversion instructions in _CHANGES.md before delivery.
Standing project conventions: data-label parity enforced across all record-list tables; counted-class floor in TestingSectionContractTests maintained; Markdown table gate must pass across all tracked documents; FOR UPDATE locking before comparisons; display_order assigned by MAX+1 not COUNT(*); stored strings not enums for event type vocabulary.
BUILD_PROGRESS.md: Too large to regenerate as a full file in some contexts — delivered as a complete file when feasible, otherwise as a targeted append block. The docs/_append/ delivery mechanism is retired; BUILD_PROGRESS.md ships whole.
Communication pattern: Kushal communicates tersely ("please continue," "go"). Claude resumes immediately without preamble. Decisions requiring a ruling are flagged before proceeding, not after.

Tools & resources

Repository: kusl/myrestaurant on GitHub (branch: main)
Local repo on Fedora 44: /home/kushal/src/dotnet/myrestaurant
Deployment: rootless Podman Compose on a Debian host ("virginia") accessible via Tailscale; Cloudflare tunnels for production ingress
Context dump: dump.txt (full repo export via export.sh, SHA-256 per file); claude-terminal.txt for build/test output
Shell scripts validated with shellcheck --severity=style (shellcheck 0.11.0) and bash -n before delivery
GitHub PAT available for read-only API calls — must never appear in any response or generated file
Primary mobile test target: iPhone SE 2020 (375px viewport)
